label: sec:brings-surface-qou-intro
html: Bring's curve \Sigma_4 = \{\sum_{j=0}^4 x_j = \sum_{j=0}^4 x_j^2 = \sum_{j=0}^4 x_j^3 = 0\} \subset \mathbb{P}^4 is the unique genus-four curve admitting a faithful action of the symmetric group S_5. This section verifies that \Sigma_4 equipped with its canonical spinor bundle and Reeb connection forms a quantum observable universe (\mathbf{C}, \varTheta, G, \mathcal{S}): it computes the Euler characteristic \chi(\Sigma_4) = -6 both via the intersection degree of the (1,2,3) complete intersection in \mathbb{P}^4 and via the Riemann–Hurwitz formula on its five-sheeted branched cover of \mathbb{P}^1, compares the topological, coherent, and categorical Euler characteristics, and constructs the five-strand braid representation B_5 \to \mathrm{Aut}(H_1(\Sigma_4, \mathbb{Z})).
